note: The fourteen children of Valentino Defranceschi and Helena/Elena, read out of the Liber Baptizatorum and the burial register of Fiume on 6 September 2026. **Every child carries a `who` slug**, because an evidence file with no key to a person is an evidence file the build will drop — and this one was dropped for eleven days. Nine of these baptism dates exist in no index and in no other file in this repository.
heading: Valentino's fourteen children, out of the Fiume register
lead: Kobler's earliest Fiume household is «Valentino Defranceschi, venuto dalla Carnia, fu fatto Cittadino nel 1739». The register says what that citizenship was for: **he had been baptising children there since 1737**, and he went on doing it for twenty years. **Nine sons and five daughters**, against a family account of ten sons and four — and five of the fourteen were buried as infants.
source: Liber Baptizatorum and the burial register of the collegiate church of St Vitus, Fiume, read 6 September 2026. **Ten of the fourteen are also indexed by FamilySearch** and stand in [the household](/households/) on those index entries; **four are not in any index at all** and exist only because the register itself was read. *(doc — read from the register; the image and ark of each entry was not kept, which is a gap of this archive's own making)*
